items.title: We Need to Prepare Ourselves for One of the Most Intensely Monitored Elections in American History
The Legal System Is Taking Another Shot at Forcing Trump to Tell the Truth About January 6
When You’ve Got 6,000 State Senate Seats to Fill, You’re Occasionally Going to Elect a Homophobic Sauerkraut Salesman
items.content: It is that time in the election cycle when we look around the country for the strange and wonderful about representative democracy.

items.title: Sorry, JD Vance—Vivek Ramaswamy Just Took the Title of Ohio’s Most Unlikable Politician
items.content: The gubernatorial candidate has associated himself with the vilest, most inhumane advertisement in the history of American politics.

items.title: Canada Rightfully Decides That It Will Never Be the 51st State
items.content: Unfortunately, that doesn’t mean the president’s influence hasn’t wafted its way to our northern neighbor like a toxic cloud.

items.title: “I’ve Never Studied the Body of a Man Before,” Says Trump Before Describing Jon Husted’s Ass in Gross Detail
items.content: Maybe the president and his favorite senator should run off into the sunset together. It would save us all a lot of grief.

items.title: The President Sure Cut the FBI’s Public Corruption Teams at a Convenient Time
items.content: The CEO of a naval firm went to prison for bribing public officials, but why aren’t the people who took his company’s money? In Trump’s America, I guess we’ll never know.

items.title: You’re Telling Me We’re Still Finding Evidence Against O.J. Simpson After All This Time?
items.content: I feel like I just stepped out of a time machine.

items.title: Trump Is Suing the BBC for a Ridiculous Reason—and a Hilariously Obnoxious Amount of Money
items.content: My guess is that this comedy extravaganza comes to a close long before it gets to trial.

items.title: In a Totally Cruel Decision, Mississippi AG Finds No Wrongdoing in the Despicable Police Shooting of a One-Year-Old Boy
items.content: Everything about the review of this heartbreaking case is fishy.

items.title: It Took Republicans This Long to Realize That Trump Is a Cancer to Their Political Party?
items.content: What tipped them off? The blatant subservience to Putin, or his pointless meddling in Israeli politics?

items.title: The Legal Proceedings Against Khalid Sheikh Mohammed Have Become an Extended Farce
items.content: The alleged “mastermind” of the 9/11 attacks is scheduled for trial in 2028, but we’ll see if that actually happens.

items.title: In Gabe Kavookjian’s Life, Most People Are the Same. But Not Him.
items.content: He’s thirty-five years old. Loves movies. Works two jobs. Wants to meet the right person. But because he has Down syndrome, someone told him he’s different.

items.title: Another Tragic Reminder: Too. Many. Damn. Guns.
items.content: Bend has done more than its part watering the tree of liberty.

items.title: You’re Not Gonna Like the List of Donors Fronting the Bill for Trump’s Big, Ugly Ballroom
items.content: A White House spokesperson called them “a wide array of great American companies and generous individuals.” I call them a bunch of influence-buying grifters.

items.title: I’m Both Elated and Terrified to Hear That Trump’s Administration Is Coming Unstrung
items.content: A disastrous new press secretary. Whispers of a new chief of staff. A feud between the president and old lawyers. We have to endure two more years of this?

items.title: Trump Wants to Sell Ukraine Out for a Couple Days’ Worth of Diesel Fuel
items.content: And you’ll never guess the pale pile of evil he brought in to help.
